svg.title: Captain bullion grade insignia, mess dress shoulder board
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"rank-senior-captain-bullion","units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,88,100],"name":"Captain bullion grade insignia, mess dress shoulder board","size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Same shape and size as the embroidered form rank-senior-captain-thread (0.88 x 1 in): CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-3 says only that the grade on the boards is metal bullion and gives no size. Male boards 5 1/2 x 2 1/4 in, female 4 1/2 x 2 in.","provenance":"recoloured from rank-senior-captain-thread: bullion silver (2d Lt and Major gold, others silver, matching the metal and thread forms); solid fills and plain strokes only, no pattern, gradient, filter, mask or clip path (LIVE10-ART 4: the pattern fill failed on the live page and the board's blue showed through); the shading lines are the form's own veins and feather detail with a light line beside them, the polygon and bar forms a light inset rim","colours":{"bullion":"#c9ced6","bullion_line":"#8f969e","bullion_edge":"#6b727a","bullion_highlight":"#e6e9ee"},"anchors":{"top_center":[44,0],"bottom_center":[44,100],"center":[44,50],"left_edge":[0,50],"right_edge":[88,50],"insignia_center":[44,50],"rank_slot_center":[44,50],"mount_center":[44,50]},"dimensions":{"form":"metal bullion grade insignia (mess dress shoulder board)","insignia_w_in":0.88,"insignia_h_in":1,"grade_edge":{"width_in":0.018,"colour":"#2c3037","placement":"inside the outline (regulation size unchanged), flat, no gradient","basis":"outline weight measured on CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-1 at 12 px/pt (0.014-0.017 in, tone 55-75/255); critique D20: silver grade nearly invisible on grey / blue boards"},"bar_count":2,"bar_length_in":1,"bar_width_in":0.32,"gap_in":0.24,"long_end":"vertical (OCP)","thread":"silver bullion","slot_fit":{"garment_rank_slot_in":{"along":1.5,"across":1.2},"piece_along_in":0.88,"piece_across_in":1,"scale_to_garment_slot":1,"note":"placement rule: leaf stem / stacked stars along the board, bars across, Colonel eagle wingspan along the board; scale < 1 only if the piece must stay inside the slot"}},"mounts":[{"uniform":"Men's mess dress shoulder boards (garment-mess-dress-male-officer-shoulder-boards)","rule":"centred on the board with the board centre line, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; board 5.5 x 2.25 in, 1/2 in dark blue lace each side (general officer boards: silver lace with 1/2 in blue lace), button at the peak (4.1.1.1.1.1, Fig A5-3). Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar, Colonel eagle beak forward (4.1.1.1.1.2-3). No distance from the board end is given by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; use the garment rank_slot centre."},{"uniform":"Women's mess dress shoulder boards (garment-mess-dress-female-officer-shoulder-boards)","rule":"centred on the board with the board centre line, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; board 4.5 x 2 in, 1/4 in blue lace each side on every grade (Fig A5-3), no button (4.1.2.1.1.1, Fig A5-3). Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar, Colonel eagle beak forward (4.1.1.1.1.2-3). No distance from the board end is given by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; use the garment rank_slot centre."}],"rank":{"grade":"Captain","abbrev":"Capt","membership":"senior"},"grade":"rank-insignia","size_in":{"w":0.88,"h":1}}
